bio: In a small alley in the cosy and bustling old town, Konoba TRS welcomes guests in an elegant setting with exposed stone walls and a beautiful outdoor area. The cuisine is Mediterranean, traditional but with some modern touches, offered mainly in a small menu or in three interesting menus of three courses each. Excellent cod fillet with mashed potatoes and beetroot powder. Particularly pleasant is the secluded and shady terrace, ideal for a quiet dinner....
